This was the perfect book to help put my SIL at ease! The author touches on really important topics such as mental health, intimacy, and communication, both before and after the baby’s arrival.
There are practical tips on how to make your partner more comfortable during pregnancy as well as everything from preparing for baby’s arrival, to dealing with prenatal appointments without feeling awkward. The book seems relatable and honest.

title: Solid Practical Advice
body: This is a helpful and encouraging guide for first-time dads who may be feeling overwhelmed by pregnancy and all the changes that come with it. I appreciated how the author walks through each stage of pregnancy, explains what dads can expect, and offers practical ways to support their partner. The sections on prenatal visits, birth plans, postpartum challenges, and preparing for the baby's arrival were especially useful. The writing is easy to follow, and the advice is realistic without being intimidating. A solid resource for any man getting ready to become a father.

title: The "Expert Friend" Voice
body: Discovering you are going to be a father is an incredible, life-altering milestone—but it is also completely normal to experience a sudden wave of panic. In You Will Rock As a Dad!, author Alex Grace delivers a compact, highly practical survival guide designed to transform anxious, first-time expectant fathers into confident, supportive parenting partners. Clocking in at just over 150 pages, this book cuts through the overwhelming medical jargon to offer a clear, actionable roadmap for the wild 40-week ride of pregnancy and early infancy.

title: Mid-Book review
body: Mid-book review on this book and it has been awesome! The practical thoughts and ideas put into this book have shown true and helpful. My “gut-wrench” part in this book thus far is making a move while your partner is pregnant. I decided to accept a job and later we found that my wife was pregnant and I was stuck. I am in the midst of fulfilling my commitment to my new job but it is eating me alive not being there for my wife during this period of time. Any prayers, words of encouragement, or just brutal honesty of what the heck am I doing is welcomed. Thank you Alex for this book and I can’t wait to continue reading.

body: Fantastic Book. I'm a first time father to be and it taught me a lot of things I would have never thought of. I read the book very quickly and know I will also teach my wife some things and will reference the book as the pregnancy progresses.

title: NOPE
body: Fell for the tiktok ads and bought this for my husband. Informative? Nope. Good for a laugh? Oh yeah. Just so hilariously bad. Fairly certain this was written by AI, and if not, I'm very concerned for this man and his wife. It is the most simplistic, heteronormative schlock, down to "women LOVE spending all your money at baby stores" or "sorry dudes, you don't have a life anymore and your wife hates you" or "mourning the loss of your weekly beer." This book is only worth the money if you need a gag gift.

title: Wish I could give the book a zero-star rating
body: If you have any genuine desire to prep yourself for fatherhood, or have a slight amount of common sense. Save yourself some money and do not buy this book. The immaturity and lack of knowledge is evident in the writing of the author after reading just the introduction. I wish I could back in time to not only save myself from wasting money on this book but from wasting precious time reading this book made for meatheads. If you are looking to give this book to someone who is immature and self its great. But if you are someone who wants to be a true partner to your spouse during such a precious time. Please don't buy or gift this book. Thank you!

title: Reassuring and
body: This book offers a wealth of insights that I found incredibly valuable. It covers a wide range of topics related to pregnancy, providing not only factual information but also emotional reassurance throughout the journey. As a future dad, I appreciated how it addressed the various stages of pregnancy, the changes involved, and the ways to support my partner during this time. The author does a fantastic job of presenting practical advice alongside heartfelt reflections, which helped me feel more prepared and less anxious about the impending arrival of our child. I wholeheartedly recommend this book to any upcoming dads who are seeking guidance and comfort as they navigate the exciting adventure of bringing a new little one into the world.

title: Essential Guide for New Dads: Confidence and Humor Combined
body: You Will Rock As a Dad! by Alex Grace is an essential read for new fathers navigating the unexpected waters of first-time parenthood. Grace combines humor with straightforward advice, addressing common fears such as, "What if I'm going to be a bad father?" He offers practical steps for engaging and preparing alongside your partner, emphasizing fatherhood's emotional and psychological aspects. This book stands out as a reassuring guide, ensuring new dads that they are not alone in their journey.

title: Ease New Dad Fears
body: Reading this book as a new dad was like someone lifted a weight off my shoulders. It covers everything from preparing for baby’s arrival to dealing with prenatal appointments without feeling lost or awkward. The writing feels relatable and honest. I'm so glad I stumbled upon this before we brought our little one into the world.

title: Unacceptable quality of product
body: I purchased 2 books for my son and daughter-in-law who are expecting their first child soon. We were visiting them when the books were delivered to them. The packaging was in good condition, but the book for my son had obviously been used- one corner of the book was turned up making it hard to turn each page, there were coffee stains and it appeared to have been dropped in water because the pages stuck together. I did not pay for a used book. I told my son I would return it, but he said he was running out of time and wanted to read it before his baby came. But I was embarrassed to death to give him this. The other book for my daughter-in-law was in perfect condition so it was not damaged in shipping. I couldn’t believe this was sent to us this way. Please see pictures. Appalling.

title: Great read!
body:
Being a father is the only profession in which the degree is awarded first and then the course is practiced. This book brings a helpful insight into what it means to be a father, and how to prepare for it. Being a parent is not a one-person job and the more prepared you are the more easily you will surmount the obstacles. It’s equally important for both parents to be ready as they experience it differently.
I’d recommend this book to all fathers, and fathers-to-be!
